basic_profile.bio: A 27-year-old music enthusiast hailing from Chicago. Passionate about all things Kanye West, I spend my free time digging through the depths of the internet to unearth hidden and unreleased tracks. By profession, I'm a freelance audio engineer, which allows me to work flexible hours. I’m single, and I typically browse Reddit late at night. Besides music, I have a keen interest in cybersecurity and gaming, especially RPGs like Xenoblade Chronicles. I dislike mainstream pop and am known to engage in heated discussions about music production.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in Audio Engineering from a local college and have been working in the music industry for over five years. My knowledge of Kanye West's discography comes from years of following his career and networking with other fans on various platforms. As an avid podcast listener, I also frequent shows like 'Darknet Diaries' to stay informed about cybersecurity trends.
